newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Basis bids mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Basis bids mostly steady.

text.p: Basis bids for hard red winter wheat in the central U.S. Plains were mostly steady Tuesday, grain dealers said.
Merchandisers in Kansas said movement had been slow Monday, although some Oklahoma dealers said they had seen a fair amount of activity.
"We did have what I'd call a decent day," a merchandiser in north central Oklahoma said.
Temperatures were moderately cold across the central Plains. By 0800 CST Tuesday, most of Kansas was in the teens (Farenheit), while Oklahoma was in the 20s.
Dealers said they were eyeing forecasts for sharply colder weather by the weekend, when a mass of Arctic air is expected to sweep the Plains.
